benefitsTitle: Built around how guests actually browse
benefitsSub: Most hotel listings are an afterthought. Hotel Gallery is the opposite — every detail is built to make your property look worth booking.

benefits.label: Photography
benefits.title: Full-screen, not cropped
benefits.desc: Every photo shows exactly as taken — vertical or horizontal — instead of squeezed into a tiny thumbnail grid.

benefits.label: Direct Contact

benefits.desc: Call and WhatsApp buttons are built in. Guests reach you directly — no OTA commission on that booking.

benefits.label: Mobile First
benefits.title: Made for the phone
benefits.desc: Over 90% of guests browse hotels on their phone. This is designed for that screen first, not squeezed to fit it.

benefits.label: Zero Effort

benefits.desc: No dashboard, no app, no learning curve. Send your photos and details — your page goes live.
